notes.title: Version 2.146 Update Notice
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35022669/997fd6a51253a1a94a4cb12f6c83e613eb72682f.jpg

Mysterious magical energy is sweeping across the Kingdom of Athena, bringing exciting changes!
Harness the power of Mana, and use it to upgrade your Buildings further and enhance the attributes of each troop type!
Embark on story quests known as Kingdom Chapters to unlock new regions in your Turf! Place and move Buildings and Decorations freely, creating a Turf that is uniquely your own! (Check the building list on the bottom left of the screen to find the Decoration feature)

# Build your dream Turf! Arrange and place Buildings and Decorations wherever you like!
# Added [Kingdom Chapters] (story quests):
．If you have not finished all Skirmishes before the maintenance, uncleared segments will be replaced by Kingdom Chapters after the maintenance
．If you have completed all Skirmishes before the maintenance, you'll unlock Kingdom Chapter 9: Mana Awakening once you reach Castle Lv 25 after the maintenance
．After the maintenance, Kingdom Chapter rewards will be unlocked based on the Skirmishes you cleared before the maintenance (these must be claimed manually)
# Mana Levels:
．After the maintenance, clear [Kingdom Chapter 9-4: Mana Lode] (requires Castle Lv 25) to unlock a new building, the [Mana Lode], where Mana Ore is produced
．Use Mana Ore and Mana Crystals (can be obtained from refining Mana Ore, and events like Dragon Arena, Chaos Arena, Guild Expedition, Kingdom Clash, Lords Cup, etc.) to upgrade the Mana Level of Lv 25 Buildings and unlock upgrade effects (please check in-game for more details)
# Mana Charge:
．Clear [Kingdom Chapter 9-5, Skirmish 9: Mana Challenge] (requires Castle Lv 25) to unlock a new building, the [Mana Chamber]
．Charge each troop type (Infantry, Ranged, and Cavalry) in the Mana Chamber to enhance their basic attributes (Note: Charging a troop type will affect all tiers that belong to that specific troop type)
# New Research Tree: [Mana Awakening] (unlocks at Academy Lv 25) 
# New Special Building: Synthesis Isle
Enjoy a fun merging game and take a break from battles! Complete Synthesis Quests to get Synthesis Badges, and increase your Synthesis Level to get level-up rewards.
# Updated Hero Stage interface to match the updated Turf style
# Added a 2nd Construction Queue: Spend Gems to rent it or make a purchase to unlock it permanently
# Various UI adjustments

The 2nd wave of the Lords Mobile x THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV collab event is here! Play the [King of Pinball] with Mai Shiranui to earn amazing prizes!
Work together with your guild to vanquish the forces of darkness in the [Darknest Crusade]!

# The [King of Pinball] collab event will start on 07/01/2024! (check in-game for event timing and rules)
．New event type! Use [Pinball Tokens] to launch balls. Hit the bumpers to earn more points
．Reach point requirements to claim rewards, and exchange [Flame Emblems] for prizes (Mai Shiranui Leader Skin, Kyo Kusanagi Castle Skin, collab avatars, collab emotes, new Artifacts, etc.) in the [Pinball Shop]
# New Trial Event: [Darknest Crusade] (check in-game for event timings, rewards, and rules)
．Only R4 & R5 members can summon event Darknests for their guild & choose challenge difficulty 
．Event summons require Dark Crests. Dark Crests will be replenished at the start of every event. Unused Dark Crests will not carry over to the next event
．5 Vanguard Darknests & 1 Commander Darknest will appear around the summoner's Turf 
．The guild must destroy all event Darknests within 3h to complete the challenge and unlock the next difficulty
# New Trial Event: Chalice Domain Migration Deal
．Starting from the end of the current Chalice Battle until the event preparation phase of the next Chalice Battle, migrating to a Kingdom within your Chalice District will only require 1 [Relocator]
(Migration restrictions based on Kingdom age will still apply. Under this new migration deal, the items used for migration will be changed from Migration Scrolls to Relocators.)
# New Domain Info: 
．Added a new button on the left side of the World Map. Tap it to check Kingdoms in your current Chalice/Feudal Domain
# Queue Adjustments:
．Will be divided into two tabs: [Turf Queues] & [Army Queues]. Added more project types to idle alerts. Tap the arrow button or anywhere in your Turf to close the queue window
．Turf Queues: Tap a queue to be redirected to the respective building or feature 
．Army Queues: Tap a queue to be redirected to your army's location
．Gathering, Camping, Garrison, Reinforcement Queues: When your army reaches their destination, they will continue to be displayed in your queue, and can be withdrawn from the queue
．New Functions: Added idle alerts for queues. Added option to auto-close queue window after speeding up marching troops. Removed [Auto-Expand Queue When Status Changes] from Functions
# Frosty Commissions Event Optimizations:      
．Lowered Might requirements to get 1 Ice Breaker for Castle Lv 5~Lv 24 (check event info for details)
．An Ice Breaker speech bubble will appear if you have unused Ice Breakers
# Fixed skill activation issue for [Don Guapo] in the Colosseum
# Various UI adjustments

notes.title: Version 2.114 Update Notice
notes.notes:
#Fixed issue where the [Promote/Demote] button disappeared in the Guild management menu for some Guild Leaders
#Fixed issue where players were unable to join Darknest Rallies after tapping on Darknest Rally messages in the Guild Chat

#GEMerous Spooktacular Event:
- Claim 200,000 Linked Gems for free in the Bargain Store & enjoy bargains at just 100 Gems each!
- Collect Creepy Candies and upgrade the Ghastly Ghoul to get loads of Linked Gems!
- Super Gem Time
- Guild Leaders can send all guildmates Magical Gem Gifts (grants up to 100,000 Linked Gems)!
- Hunt down various Monsters to get Equipment Materials!
- Take on Petite Devil's Limited Challenge!
- A mystery event will also randomly appear!
(Check the Events Board for event timings and details)

#Gem Update:
- There will be two kinds of Gems: Giftable Gems (marked with sparkles) and Linked Gems.
- All Gems owned and obtained from chests (excluding Guild Gifts) prior to the update will become Giftable Gems.
- After the update, Giftable Gems can be obtained from making purchases in the in-game Mall, and the jackpots from the Labyrinth, Labyrinth Challenge, Kingdom Tycoon, and Tycoon Challenge. Gems obtained through all other means will be Linked Gems.
- Both types of Gems will serve the same purpose as Gems did before, the only difference being that only Giftable Gems can be used to send gifts to your fellow Guild members via the Gift Shop: Gem Gifts.

# Familiar Support Skill [Stroke of Fortune]: Increased the number of Gems obtained from this skill
# Auto-Join Darknest Rally optimizations:
- Players can toggle Auto-Join on and off, and set Wait Time when starting a Darknest Rally
- Rallies will have a buffer of 30 troops where Auto-Join troops will not be accepted, only troops that are manually sent out.
# Guild optimizations: 
- Added [Inner Circle]: Guild Leaders can add guildmates to the Inner Circle, who can instantly join the Guild without the need for their application to be approved or for any Might requirements to be met. Their Guild Rank will also be remembered and changed automatically.
- Guild Search & Recommendations: Added [Advanced Search], where players can search for Guilds based on their event rankings (Guild Fest, Dragon Arena)
- Guild recruitment settings: Can now set [Might] requirement 
# Revamped player profile interface:
- Optimized 3D character’s display area, adjusted Player Level display, removed Energy information 
- Merged Boosts & Stats into one page
# Optimized Labyrinth Challenge, Tycoon Challenge, and Artifact Challenge:
- Added display of Top 3 players. Tap to switch display to the 3 most recent jackpot winners. Optimized interface buttons.
- Added new alerts for rare rewards (Leader Skin Portraits, Artifact Shards) in Challenge Shops
# Artifacts: Optimized Artifact Fair interface configuration and buttons

[Update Note]
Change is coming to the Royal Battleground! Seize this chance to claim the throne and rule your Dominion!

# Kingdoms participating in Royal Battleground events (Battle Royals, Feudal Battles, Chalice Battles) will be divided into separate Dominions (effective next Battle Royal onward. Feudal/Chalice Battles before this will not be affected)
# About Dominions:
．Kingdoms will be divided into separate Dominions: Dominion 1 (Restricted Kingdoms), Dominion 2 (Partially Restricted 1), Dominion 3 (Partially Restricted 2), and Permanent Dominion (Kingdoms with no migration restrictions). Players will battle other players in their home Dominion (with the exception of those in protected Kingdoms) during Royal Battleground events
．Home Dominion will change as your Kingdom ages or if you migrate to another Kingdom
# Dominion Prizes:
．Each Dominion will have its own ranking board and rewards. The Permanent Dominion is made up of the oldest Kingdoms, and Battle Royal rewards will remain unchanged in this Dominion. Other Dominions will offer different Battle Royal rewards.
．All Dominions will also offer ranking rewards to Rank 4-10 players
．Players can check their home Dominion and the ranking rewards on the event page as soon as the Preparation Phase begins
# Ranking Adjustments: World Rankings have been changed to Dominion Rankings, and will show the top 100 players and guilds in the player's home Dominion
# New Migration Restrictions (tap  on the World Map for details):
．Added Partially Restricted 3, 4, 5
．Kingdoms who leave Partially Restricted 2 after the maintenance will move to Partially Restricted 3
．Kingdoms with no Migration Restrictions before the maintenance will not be affected
# Mall Update: Find Subscriptions and the Breakthrough Bonus in the Passes page in the Mall after the update!
# Various UI adjustments

Test your strength against loads of [Trial By Fire] stages without the fear of losing your precious troops! Prove yourself in these trials and hone your strategies!

# New [Trial By Fire] system (reach Castle Lv 6 & clear Skirmish 2 to unlock):
- Take on the [Trial By Fire] challenge to increase your battle prowess and test your strategies in countless stages!
- Trial By Fire can be found in Perilous Ridge (second Turf region).
- Trial By Fire stages are split based on the enemy's configuration. Clear stages to win rewards.
- You can use the highest troop tiers you've unlocked in Trial By Fire stages. Troops used will be provided by Trial By Fire, and no actual troops will be lost.
- Rewards available: Artifact Shards, Archaic Tomes, Equipment materials, Speed Up items, Guild Coins, and more. The higher the stage level, the better the rewards.
# New [Do Not Disturb] notification setting: You will not receive any notifications if your enemy's Might is below the set value when you are attacked, scouted, or rallied.

notes.title: [Notice] Duplicate purchase issue in Steam version
notes.notes:
We recently discovered a duplicate purchase issue in the Steam version for [One-Time Offer] packs. After our investigation, we have determined that this issue was caused by clicking the buy button multiple times under a laggy connection.

To prevent any unnecessary losses, please be patient when buying a [One-Time Offer] pack, and do not click the button multiple times to ensure that you are not billed again.

Thank you for your support and understanding.

The Dragon Arena is an ancient battleground that has recently been rediscovered. Now war rages anew, in a bid to claim the precious Dragite!
